description: Defines the SystemConsoleSidebar class and related sidebar category classes for the Mattermost system console UI, using Playwright for testing.

classes.name: SystemConsoleSidebar
classes.description: Represents the sidebar component in the system console UI, providing methods to interact with various categories and sections.

classes.name: SidebarSection
classes.description: Represents a clickable section within a sidebar category, with methods to click and check active state.

classes.name: SidebarCategory
classes.description: Base class for sidebar categories, managing section links and visibility.

classes.name: AboutCategory
classes.description: Sidebar category for 'About' settings, including 'Edition and License'.

classes.name: UserManagementCategory
classes.description: Sidebar category for user management settings.

classes.name: SystemAttributesCategory
classes.description: Sidebar category for system attributes settings.

classes.name: SiteConfigurationCategory
classes.description: Sidebar category for site configuration settings.

classes.name: PluginsCategory
classes.description: Sidebar category for plugin management and related sections.

classes.name: IntegrationsCategory
classes.description: Sidebar category for integrations and API-related settings.

classes.name: ComplianceCategory
classes.description: Sidebar category for compliance and audit settings.

classes.name: ExperimentalCategory
classes.description: Sidebar category for experimental features and feature flags.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Checks if the sidebar and header are visible.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Fills the search input with specified text.

methods.name: getPlugin
methods.description: Retrieves a plugin section by name.
